market_opportunities: AI安全审计工具可针对LLM-求解器混合推理管道的"叙述环节"开发专项检测与加固方案，服务金融、医疗、法律等对结论可靠性要求极高的行业客户
创业团队可围绕"叙述加固即服务"（Narration Hardening as a Service）打造产品，为使用SAT/SMT求解器的AI系统提供对抗性提示注入防护与持续监控
AI Agent平台可集成该论文的证书门控（certificate gating）机制作为基础安全组件，并向用户展示"推理可靠性仪表盘"，区分求解器裁决与叙述生成的可信度

risk_matrix.regulatory: 若LLM-求解器混合管道应用于金融风控、医疗诊断、法律裁决等受监管领域，叙述鸿沟的存在可能导致监管机构要求对AI输出进行全程形式化验证，追溯责任归属面临法律挑战
risk_matrix.technological: 论文实证表明强化提示无法消除自适应攻击风险，说明目前没有彻底的技术解决方案，相关产品在安全关键场景中可能被证伪，长期面临替代方案（端到端形式化叙述生成）的竞争
risk_matrix.competitive: 头部云厂商若率先将叙述鸿沟防护集成到AI平台层（如Vertex AI、Amazon Bedrock），将挤压第三方安全工具的市场空间；开源社区可能出现标准化加固方案，降低差异化优势
risk_matrix.ethical: 在安全攸关场景中，用户可能被经过操纵的AI叙述误导做出错误决策，且因求解器层看起来"可靠"而产生虚假安全感；此类漏洞在自动驾驶、电网调度等高危场景中可能造成物理伤害
additional: 信任悬崖风险：一旦该漏洞被广泛披露，用户对AI求解器混合系统的整体信任可能骤降，连带影响尚未受到攻击的系统
供应链风险：下游应用依赖上游LLM API或求解器服务，任何一层的叙述脆弱性都可能传导至最终输出

articles.title: LLM Doesn't Know What It Doesn't Know: Detecting Epistemic Blind Spots via Cross-Model Attribution Divergence on Clinical Tabular Data
author: [[Akshat Dasula, Prasanna Desikan, Jaideep Srivastava]]
articles.description: arXiv:2606.19509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to structured clinical data, yet whether they can recognize the limits of their own knowledge on such tasks remains unexplored. We study this question through the lens of cross-model attribution divergence with the goal of reducing epistemic uncertainty for structured tasks, comparing Qwen 2.5 7B and XGBoost on a prediction task via attribution divergence analysis. We report four findings. First, LLM verbalized confidence is epistemically vacuous, it outputs a near-constant (0.856-0.937) regardless of whether accuracy is 49% or 75.3%, tracking prompt format rather than prediction quality. Second, the LLM exhibits an inverse difficulty effect: accuracy drops to 64.8% when XGBoost is 99% correct, but matches XGBoost (73.8% vs. 73.1%) when it is moderately uncertain. Third, few-shot examples and SHAP-derived feature evidence are orthogonal, super-additive interventions: they reduce the Attribution Disagreement Score (ADS) from 1.54 to 0.38 and improve accuracy from 49% to 75.3% without training. Fourth, a cross-model calibrator that determined LLM reliability using attribution divergence signals reduces expected calibration error from 0.254 to 0.080, replacing uninformative verbalized confidence with patient-specific reliability estimates, without accessing model internals or requiring repeated inference. We frame these findings as a cold start problem for LLMs on structured data and outline a path toward genuine epistemic self-awareness.
articles.tldr: 研究发现LLM在结构化临床数据上无法认知自身知识边界，口头置信度与预测质量脱钩
articles.objective_summary: 该论文通过交叉模型归因散度分析，对比Qwen 2.5 7B与XGBoost在临床表格数据预测任务上的表现，发现LLM口头置信度呈恒定值（0.856-0.937），与准确率无关。少样本示例与SHAP特征证据具有超加性协同效应，可将准确率从49%提升至75.3%。交叉模型校准器将期望校准误差从0.
key_logic_flow: 论文研究LLM在结构化临床数据上是否能识别自身知识极限（认知盲区），通过交叉模型归因散度分析来降低认知不确定性。
发现一：LLM的口头置信度在认知上是空洞的——无论准确率是49%还是75.3%，其输出值恒定在0.856-0.937之间，反映的是提示格式而非预测质量。
发现二：LLM呈现"逆难度效应"——当XGBoost以99%确定时LLM准确率降至64.8%，当XGBoost中度不确定时两者表现接近（73.8% vs 73.1%）。
发现三：少样本示例与SHAP特征证据是正交且超加性的干预手段——归因不一致分数（ADS）从1.54降至0.38，准确率从49%提升至75.3%，无需训练。
发现四：利用归因散度信号的交叉模型校准器可将期望校准误差从0.254降至0.080，为患者提供个性化的可靠性估计，无需访问模型内部或重复推理。
论文将这些发现框定为LLM在结构化数据上的冷启动问题，并提出了实现真正的认知自我意识的路径。

impact_score.reason: 该论文揭示了LLM在结构化临床数据上的一个根本性缺陷——口头置信度与预测质量完全脱钩，这对AI可靠性研究和临床部署有重要警示意义。四个发现（置信度空洞化、逆难度效应、少样本与SHAP的超加性协同、交叉模型校准器）都有充分的实验支撑，尤其是校准误差从0.254降至0.080的改进具有实操价值。但这是一篇学术论文而非产品发布或范式突破，其方法（对比XGBoost归因分歧）在架构层面并非颠覆性创新，短期内对AI行业竞争格局影响有限。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: LLM口头置信度在结构化数据任务上是空洞的，无法反映真实预测质量，这对依赖LLM置信度做决策的应用构成风险

hype_assessment.reason: 该论文没有使用'颠覆性'、'革命性'等PR话术，而是严谨地报告实验发现和数值结果。标题'LLM Doesn't Know What It Doesn't Know'虽然是引人注意的表述，但论文内容扎实，提供了完整的实验设计、消融研究和数据支撑，属于实打实的学术贡献。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 提出了交叉模型归因散度分析方法，通过对比LLM（Qwen 2.5 7B）与传统梯度提升模型（XGBoost）在SHAP特征归因上的分歧来量化LLM的认知不确定性，无需访问模型内部状态或重复推理，即可在个体预测层面提供可靠性估计。
domain_disruption.business_model: 对临床AI辅助诊断系统的验证和合规流程有潜在影响——如果LLM的口头置信度不可靠，未来临床AI产品可能需要强制集成外部校准器或与传统ML模型做交叉验证，这会催生新的AI审计和可靠性认证服务细分市场。

compound_value.reason: 该论文从实证角度验证了一个关键命题：LLM在结构化临床数据上存在认知盲区，口头置信度与预测质量完全脱钩（恒定0.856-0.937，无论准确率是49%还是75.3%）。这一发现对医疗、金融等高风险领域的AI部署具有直接警示价值和工程指引。交叉模型校准器利用归因散度信号，无需访问模型内部即可将校准误差从0.254降至0.080，具备嵌入MLOps监控平台或Agent可靠性评估层的落地潜力。少样本+SHAP的超加性协同效应也指向混合AI架构（LLM+传统ML）的实用方向。但作为单一学术论文（arXiv），仅覆盖结构化表格数据场景，尚未经过大规模生产环境验证，产品化路径不明。中长期价值在于：1）推动AI可靠性评估中间件的标准化；2）为混合AI架构提供理论支撑；3）可能催生独立于基础模型的信任验证层。综合评分中等偏上，需跟踪后续研究和商业化进展，短期内不会直接改变竞争格局。

competitive_casualty: 纯LLM医疗应用公司
依赖口头置信度的评估工具
闭源黑盒临床AI系统
market_opportunities: 临床决策支持系统开发者可基于交叉模型校准框架（LLM + XGBoost），在零训练成本下为每个预测输出个性化的可靠性估计，直接解决LLM置信度空洞问题，提升AI辅助诊断的可信度和监管合规性
归因散度（ADS）检测方法可产品化为LLM知识边界审计SaaS工具，面向医疗、金融等强监管行业，提供结构化数据场景下的模型盲区扫描服务
少样本示例与SHAP特征证据的正交超加性范式可被封装为即插即用的推理增强模块，在不需要微调的前提下显著提升垂直领域零样本推理的准确率和可解释性

risk_matrix.regulatory: 医疗AI监管风险：论文证实在结构化临床数据上LLM口头置信度与预测质量完全脱钩，若直接部署LLM进行临床决策而未加校准干预，可能违反FDA SaMD等医疗器械法规对算法可靠性验证的强制性要求
risk_matrix.technological: 技术替代风险：XGBoost在结构化数据上全面优于纯LLM基线，LLM在该场景的边际价值被显著高估；交叉模型校准依赖替代模型（XGBoost）的存在，若替代模型不可用则校准方法失效
risk_matrix.competitive: 竞争格局风险：主流LLM厂商若在下一代模型中直接内化校准机制或归因散度检测，当前独立的第三方校准工具将失去差异化优势
risk_matrix.ethical: 伦理风险：LLM呈现'逆难度效应'（最难样本上表现最差）且口头置信度完全不变，患者和医生可能因虚假的高置信度而做出错误治疗决策，构成严重的安全隐患
additional: 论文实验仅基于Qwen 2.5 7B单一模型和临床表格数据，结论在GPT-4/Claude等更强模型以及金融、法律等其他结构化数据领域的泛化性尚未验证
交叉模型校准器的实际部署需同时维护LLM和传统模型两套推理管线，增加了系统复杂度和运维成本

articles.title: The first big exit in AI
articles.description: little tools for making life easier
articles.tldr: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元全股票交易收购 Cursor，成为 AI 领域首个重大退出事件
articles.objective_summary: 2026年6月，SpaceX 以 600 亿美元全股票交易收购 AI 编程工具公司 Cursor。Cursor 在首届 Compile 大会上同时发布代码托管平台 Origin、本地与云端 agent 过渡功能，并预告了全新 Cursor 模型。
key_logic_flow: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元全股票交易收购 AI 编程工具公司 Cursor，成为 AI 领域首个重大退出事件。
Cursor 在首届 Compile 大会上发布 Origin（代码托管/Git 托管平台，定位 GitHub 替代品），以及本地与云端 agent 平滑过渡功能，并预告了超越编程能力的新 Cursor 模型。
Midjourney 成立新部门 Midjourney Medical，开发超声波身体扫描仪，并在旧金山开设 Spa。
OpenAI 2025 年审计财报被泄露：收入 130.7 亿美元，成本 340 亿美元。
Google Gemini 联合负责人、Transformer 论文合著者 Noam Shazeer 加入 OpenAI。
Shopify Spring '26 Edition 允许开发者通过 Catalog API 和 Universal Commerce Protocol 构建端到端 agentic 电商体验。

impact_score.reason: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 是 AI 领域首个达到此量级的退出事件，标志着 AI 创业生态从'烧钱投入期'进入'资本回收期'的转折点。这一估值远超此前 AI 公司的并购记录（如 Google 收购 DeepMind 约 5 亿美元、Microsoft 投资 OpenAI 共约 130 亿美元但非全资收购），将显著提振一级市场对 AI 工具赛道的信心，并可能引发科技巨头对 AI 编程助手的收购潮。然而 SpaceX 并非传统软件/AI 公司，跨界整合的不确定性降低了事件的范式转移级别；同时 Cursor 作为产品仍在快速迭代中（刚发布 Origin 和本地/云端 agent 过渡功能），其独立发展路径可能因收购而改变，因此评分为 7.5 而非更高。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: SpaceX 跨界收购后 Cursor 的产品独立性、开源承诺及路线图是否会偏离开发者社区利益

hype_assessment.reason: 'First big exit in AI' 的表述基本成立——600 亿美元级别在 AI 领域的并购史上确实前所未有。但该说法存在一定 PR 包装：首先，DeepMind、GitHub Copilot（依托 OpenAI 技术）等早期 AI 资产已有退出先例；其次，SpaceX 是航天/制造企业而非 AI 或软件公司，此收购更多体现 Elon Musk 的个人战略布局而非行业普遍趋势；最后，全股票交易的结构使得实际退出价值取决于 SpaceX 自身的估值稳定性。部分媒体可能过度渲染'AI 泡沫终结'或'AI 黄金时代开启'的二元叙事，需要谨慎看待。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: Cursor 在 Compile 大会上发布的 Origin 代码托管平台定位为 GitHub 替代品，以及本地与云端 agent 的平滑过渡能力，属于产品层面的差异化迭代；预告的'超越编程能力的新 Cursor 模型'暗示了从代码助手向通用 agent 的演进方向，但细节尚未披露，不构成底层技术突破。
domain_disruption.business_model: 600 亿美元全股票交易为 AI 工具赛道建立了明确的退出估值锚点，将刺激更多资本涌入 AI 编程助手与开发者工具领域。Cursor 同时布局代码托管（Origin）直接挑战 Microsoft/GitHub 的平台霸权，叠加 Shopify 发布的 Universal Commerce Protocol 允许构建端到端 agentic 电商体验，暗示着 AI 时代开发者工具链和电商基础设施正在经历平台级重构。

compound_value.reason: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元全股票收购 Cursor 是 AI 领域首个标志性大规模退出事件，其长期复利效应体现在三个层面：首先，它为 AI 初创公司的早期投资者提供了明确的估值锚点和退出路径验证，将系统性推高资本向 AI 应用层的配置意愿，形成一个正向资本循环；其次，这笔交易验证了 AI 原生开发者工具这一赛道的价值创造能力——Cursor 从 0 到 600 亿的路径将成为新一代创业者的叙事范本，吸引顶尖人才涌入；第三，Cursor 获得 SpaceX 的工程文化、长期主义资本和真实场景资源后，有能力在模型自研（已预告新模型）、代码托管（Origin 挑战 GitHub）和 Agent 基础设施三个方向同时发力，形成独特的垂直整合优势。但需注意风险：交易的特殊性（非传统科技公司收购，SpaceX 的明星效应和使命驱动型买方特点）使其不可完全复制，且 600 亿估值可能包含人才获取和品牌溢价成分。综合来看，这是 AI 产业资本化进程中里程碑式的事件，复利效应显著。

competitive_casualty: GitHub
Microsoft Copilot
JetBrains
OpenAI
market_opportunities: SpaceX以600亿美元收购Cursor标志着AI编程工具赛道的首个重大退出，创业者可借鉴此路径，聚焦AI原生代码编辑与协作工具的垂直领域微调或行业定制方案
Cursor推出Origin代码托管平台挑战GitHub，表明AI原生开发者工具链正在重构，可围绕AI驱动的代码审查、项目管理与知识库一体化平台寻找创业机会
Shopify Spring '26允许开发者构建端到端agentic电商体验，结合Catalog API和Universal Commerce Protocol，可开发面向中小商家的AI电商Agent中间件或垂直SaaS解决方案

risk_matrix.regulatory: SpaceX作为受严格监管的航天/国防承包商跨界收购AI公司，可能面临美国CFIUS国家安全审查及反垄断执法机构的重点关注；OpenAI审计财报泄露涉及SEC信息披露合规问题
risk_matrix.technological: Cursor被非软件巨头SpaceX收购后，技术人才流失风险和独立创新力下降是现实隐患；AI编程助手赛道竞争急剧升温（Vercel Eve、Microsoft Copilot Cowork、Factory AI等），架构快速迭代导致先发优势难以维持
risk_matrix.competitive: 600亿美元估值锚定拉高了AI初创公司的退出预期，后续融资和并购谈判更为复杂；Vercel、Microsoft、Google、Anthropic等巨头正在加速布局同类产品，生态挤压效应显著
risk_matrix.ethical: AI编程工具能力跃升加剧初级开发者就业替代焦虑；Midjourney进入医疗影像领域（Midjourney Medical）引发医疗AI诊断准确性和患者数据隐私的伦理争议；Agent自主编程能力的提高带来代码质量和安全归属问题

articles.title: Kilo-Org/kilocode
articles.description: Kilo is the all-in-one agentic engineering platform. Build, ship, and iterate faster with the most popular open source coding agent. English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 한국어 | Deutsch | Español | Français | Italiano | Dansk | 日本語 | Polski | Русский | Bosanski | العربية | Norsk | Português (Brasil) | ไทย | Türkçe | Українська | বাংলা | Ελληνικά | Tiếng Việt The open source coding agent for building with AI in VS Code, JetBrains, or the CLI. Kilo Code is an AI coding agent that meets you everywhere you work: VS Code, JetBrains, and the CLI. It's open source with open pricing. You pick from 500+ models, switch between them mid-task, and pay the model provider's rate with zero markup. No API keys required to start. Installation Pick where you want to run Kilo. VS Code Install the Kilo Code extension directly, or grab it from the VS Code Marketplace. Create an account and you'll have access to 500+ models including GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, all at provider pricing. CLI # npm npm install -g @kilocode/cli # curl curl -fsSL https://kilo.ai/cli/install | bash # pnpm pnpm add -g @kilocode/cli # bun bun add -g @kilocode/cli # Homebrew (macOS / Linux) brew install Kilo-Org/tap/kilo # Arch Linux (AUR) paru -S kilo-bin Then run kilo in any project directory to start. JetBrains Install the Kilo Code plugin from the JetBrains Marketplace, or search "Kilo Code" in Settings → Plugins inside any JetBrains IDE. Cloud Agent Run Kilo from the web, no local machine needed, at app.kilo.ai/cloud. Code Reviews Set up automated AI code reviews on your pull requests at app.kilo.ai/code-reviews. KiloClaw Spin up your always-on AI agent at app.kilo.ai/claw. Install the CLI from GitHub Releases (binaries) Download the latest binary from the Releases page. Platform Asset Windows (most PCs) kilo-windows-x64.zip macOS (Apple Silicon) kilo-darwin-arm64.zip macOS (Intel) kilo-darwin-x64.zip Linux x64 kilo-linux-x64.tar.gz Linux ARM kilo-linux-arm64.tar.gz Notes: x64-baseline is a compatibility build for older CPUs without AVX. musl is the statically linked build for Alpine or minimal Docker images without glibc. kilo-vscode-*.vsix is the VS Code extension package, not the CLI. Source code archives are for building from source. Agents Kilo ships with specialized agents you switch between depending on the task. You can also build your own custom agents. Code - The default. Implements and edits code from natural language. Plan - Designs architecture and writes implementation plans before any code gets written. Ask - Answers questions about your codebase without touching any files. Debug - Troubleshoots and traces issues. Review - Reviews your changes and surfaces issues across performance, security, style, and test coverage. Learn more about agents and custom agents. What it does Code generation from natural language, across multiple files. Inline autocomplete with ghost-text suggestions and tab to accept. Self-checking so the agent reviews and corrects its own work. Terminal and browser control to run commands and automate the web. MCP marketplace to find and wire up MCP servers that extend what the agent can do. 500+ models with mid-task switching, so you can match latency, cost, and reasoning to the job. Autonomous Mode (CI/CD) Run kilo run with --auto for fully autonomous operation with no prompts, built for CI/CD pipelines: kilo run --auto "run tests and fix any failures" --auto disables all permission prompts and lets the agent execute any action without confirmation. Only use it in trusted environments. Documentation For configuration and everything else, head over to the docs. Contributing Contributions are welcome from developers, writers, and everyone in between. Start with the Contributing Guide for environment setup, coding standards, and how to open a pull request. See RELEASING.md for the VS Code extension and CLI release process, and packages/kilo-jetbrains/RELEASING.md for the JetBrains plugin. Please review our Code of Conduct before getting involved. License MIT. You're free to use, modify, and distribute this code, including commercially, as long as you keep the attribution and license notices. See License. FAQ Where did Kilo CLI come from? Kilo CLI is a fork of OpenCode, enhanced to work within the Kilo agentic engineering platform. Join the community Discord | X | Reddit
articles.tldr: Kilo Code 开源 AI 编程代理，支持 VS Code、JetBrains 和 CLI，提供 500+ 模型。
articles.objective_summary: Kilo-Org 发布了开源 AI 编程代理 Kilo Code，支持在 VS Code、JetBrains 和 CLI 三种环境中运行。提供 500+ 模型（含 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Gemini 3.
key_logic_flow: Kilo Code 是一个开源 AI 编程代理，可在 VS Code、JetBrains 和 CLI 三种环境中使用。
用户可从 500+ 模型中选择，包括 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview，按模型提供商原价计费，零加价。
提供五种专用代理模式：Code（编码）、Plan（架构设计）、Ask（问答）、Debug（调试）和 Review（代码审查），用户也可构建自定义代理。
支持代码生成、内联自动补全、自我检查、终端和浏览器控制以及 MCP 市场扩展等核心功能。
支持 kilo run --auto 全自动运行模式，无需人工确认，适用于 CI/CD 流水线。
Kilo CLI 是 OpenCode 的一个分支，以 MIT 许可证发布。

impact_score.reason: Kilo Code 是 AI 编程代理赛道的新入场者，该赛道已有 Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Windsurf、Continue.dev 等成熟产品。其核心差异化在于：开源 MIT 协议、三端覆盖（VS Code + JetBrains + CLI）、500+ 模型零加价、以及内置 MCP 市场。这些特性组合在一起具有竞争力，但并非范式级突破——CLI 本质上是 OpenCode 的分支增强，而非从零构建。对局部竞争格局（尤其是开源编程代理和 IDE 插件生态）会产生一定冲击，但不足以改变整个行业的走向。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 开源 MIT 协议 + 500+ 模型按提供商原价计费，零加价，对开发者钱包友好

hype_assessment.reason: GitHub README 的行文风格相对务实，列出了具体的功能特性、安装方式和定价策略，没有使用 '颠覆'、'革命性' 等 PR 夸张词汇。500+ 模型的数量标注虽有一定宣传成分，但作为可验证的事实陈述尚在合理范围内。整体水分较低。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 在 OpenCode 分支基础上进行了全栈增强：统一 Agent 抽象层横跨 VS Code、JetBrains、CLI 三种运行环境，MCP 市场提供开箱即用的工具扩展能力，五种专用代理模式（Code/Plan/Ask/Debug/Review）加上自定义代理支持，以及 --auto 全自动 CI/CD 集成模式。技术架构本身并非颠覆性创新，但集成度和工程完成度较高。
domain_disruption.business_model: 零加价定价（按模型提供商原价计费）直接挑战 Cursor 和 Copilot 的订阅制 SaaS 模式，配合 MIT 开源协议，有望将编程代理层商品化，迫使竞品在增值服务而非模型差价上竞争。这种策略可能重构编程助手类产品的商业模式。

compound_value.reason: Kilo Code 以开源（MIT）+ 多平台（VS Code、JetBrains、CLI）+ 500+ 模型零加价的组合切入 AI 编程代理赛道，直击当前市场两大痛点：模型锁定（Cursor/Copilot 绑定单一模型生态）和平台锁定。其内置 MCP 市场为第三方工具链提供了分发渠道，具备构建双边网络效应的潜力；CI/CD 全自动模式（--auto）则打开了企业级 DevEx 场景。但该赛道已极度拥挤（Cursor 估值超百亿、Copilot 有微软渠道优势、Windsurf 等竞品融资充裕），且 Kilo CLI fork 自 OpenCode，核心技术差异尚未充分证明。长期复利取决于社区采纳速度、MCP 生态粘性以及能否在零加价策略下找到可持续的盈利模式（如企业版或市场抽成）。

competitive_casualty: GitHub Copilot
Cursor (Anysphere)
JetBrains AI Assistant
Windsurf (Codeium)
market_opportunities: 企业开发团队可基于 Kilo Code 的开源架构和零加价模型策略，搭建私有化的 AI 编程基础设施，规避单一供应商锁定并降低长期使用成本
围绕 MCP 市场的生态扩展，第三方开发者可开发垂直领域（如安全审计、数据库管理、云部署）的 MCP 服务器，通过平台分发获取收益
kilo run --auto 全自动模式为 DevOps 团队提供了将 AI 代码修复嵌入 CI/CD 流水线的机会，可大幅缩短从测试失败到修复的闭环时间

risk_matrix.regulatory: kilo run --auto 模式完全禁用人工确认，在受监管行业（金融、医疗、关键基础设施）中使用可能违反 AI Act 等法规对高风险自动化系统的透明度与人工监督要求；自动生成的代码若引入安全漏洞，责任归属尚不明确
risk_matrix.technological: CLI 基于 OpenCode 分支，需持续跟踪上游变更以避免分叉过深导致维护成本激增；500+ 模型依赖第三方 API，任一模型提供商的接口变更或服务中断都可能影响核心功能稳定性
risk_matrix.competitive: AI 编程代理赛道高度拥挤，GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Windsurf、Amazon Q Developer 等已占据大量开发者心智与市场份额，Kilo Code 作为新入场者面临极强生态挤压和获客挑战；零加价定价模式虽利好用户，但 Kilo-Org 自身盈利能力存疑
risk_matrix.ethical: 全自动模式在 CI/CD 中执行代码修改缺乏人工审查环节，存在引入后门、数据投毒或意外破坏性变更的风险；代码通过 500+ 第三方模型传输引发数据隐私泄露担忧，企业代码资产可能未经充分保护即暴露于外部模型
additional: 零加价+开源模式意味着 Kilo-Org 需要找到可持续的盈利路径（企业版、托管服务或数据变现），若商业模式不清晰可能导致项目维护力度不足或突然转向

articles.title: owainlewis/awesome-artificial-intelligence
articles.description: A curated list of Artificial Intelligence (AI) courses, books, video lectures and papers.Awesome Artificial Intelligence A curated collection of must-use, actively maintained resources for building and shipping AI systems. Focus: AI engineering (RAG, agents, evals, guardrails, deploy) plus the best books, guides, papers, and a carefully selected set of tools. 📚 Learn Deep, durable knowledge — still valuable five years from now. Books Modern & Practical Designing Machine Learning Systems — Scalable, maintainable ML pipelines (Chip Huyen). AI Engineering — End-to-end AI product building (Chip Huyen). Build a Large Language Model from Scratch — Transformers in raw PyTorch, layer by layer (Sebastian Raschka). Hands-On Large Language Models — Visual + practical guide to LLM applications (Jay Alammar, Maarten Grootendorst). LLM Engineer's Handbook — Production LLMOps: fine-tuning, quantization, serving (Labonne, Iusztin). The 100-Page Language Models Book — Concise, math-grounded path from n-grams to transformers (Andriy Burkov). Generative Deep Learning (2nd Edition) — GANs, VAEs, diffusion models (David Foster). Foundational Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach — The canonical AI theory text (Russell, Norvig). Deep Learning — Mathematical foundations of neural networks (Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville). Deep Learning: Foundations and Concepts — Bishop's 2024 update; probability-grounded modern DL (Bishop & Bishop). Understanding Deep Learning — Math + intuition + Python notebooks (Simon Prince). Speech and Language Processing (3rd Edition) — The NLP reference, kept current through the deep learning era (Jurafsky, Martin). Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd Edition) — RL foundations (Sutton, Barto). Courses Beginner Google Generative AI Learning Path Hugging Face LLM Course Fast.ai — Practical Deep Learning Intermediate / Advanced Stanford CS324: Large Language Models Full Stack Deep Learning MIT 6.S191: Intro to Deep Learning Focused DeepLearning.AI Short Courses Google DeepMind — Introduction to Reinforcement Learning Karpathy — Neural Networks: Zero to Hero Landmark Papers Research that shaped modern AI — worth reading to understand the "why" behind today's architectures. Attention Is All You Need — Transformer architecture. Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models — Model/data/compute scaling. Language Models are Few-Shot Learners — GPT-3 capabilities. Constitutional AI — Safer model alignment. 🛠 Build The toolchain for building with AI. Personal note: you don't need tons of frameworks — start with simple LLM calls and work up. Guides & Playbooks Building Effective Agents (Anthropic) — ⭐ Patterns, pitfalls, and tradeoffs for designing AI agents. OpenAI Agents Guide — Practical guide on building agents. Google AI Agents Paper — Practical guide to building AI agents from Google. Google Agents Companion Paper — Companion guide from Google. OpenAI Cookbook — Example code, recipes, and best practices for working with OpenAI APIs. LLM Engineer Handbook — A goldmine of useful links for AI engineers. Frameworks PocketFlow — Extremely minimalist AI agent framework in just 100 lines of code. Fantastic way to learn. Google ADK — Google's Agent Development Kit (Python, Java). Great local development experience + A2A + MCP. Pydantic-AI — Typed, structured LLM orchestration framework built on Pydantic models for safe, predictable outputs. LangGraph — Build multi-agent workflows with stateful graphs on top of LangChain. CrewAI — Agent orchestration with structured tasks and human-in-the-loop controls. AutoGen — Microsoft's framework for multi-agent conversation and collaboration. LlamaIndex — Data framework for ingesting, indexing, and querying private data with LLMs. Haystack — Open-source search/RAG framework with modular pipelines. Docling — Great library for ingesting any kind of document for RAG ⭐ Evals OpenAI Evals — OpenAI's framework for writing evals. IDEs Cursor — LLM-powered IDE for multi-file edits and codebase-aware chat. GitHub Copilot — In-IDE code completion, chat, and refactors. 🤖 Agents Harnesses that turn LLMs into autonomous workers. The model is swappable; the harness is the product. Coding For live capability comparison, see Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench. Claude Code — Anthropic's CLI agent; multi-file codebase refactoring with long context. Codex CLI — OpenAI's Rust-based local terminal agent; lightweight and fast. Gemini CLI — Google's official open-source terminal agent; long-context repo exploration. Cursor CLI — Cursor's terminal-native agent with sandboxed permissions. Aider — Git-integrated pair programming with surgical edits and undo. OpenCode — Provider-agnostic terminal harness with a strong TUI. OpenHands — Open-source autonomous SWE platform; browser + shell + editor loop. Cline — Open-source agentic IDE extension with strong multi-provider support. Continue — Open-source IDE + CLI assistant with source-controlled rules. Goose — Block's extensible, MCP-driven local agent. Factory Droid — Benchmark-leading multi-model harness with BYOK local execution. Amp — Sourcegraph's commercial agentic coding tool with strong product UX. Mistral Vibe — Mistral's agentic coding CLI, powered by Devstral. Qwen Code — Alibaba's terminal coding agent, optimized for Qwen models. Pi — Highly customizable terminal harness; minimal base prompt, extension-driven. Nanocoder — Private, local-first agent for Ollama and LM Studio. Kilo CLI — Multi-mode agent with a unified gateway to 500+ models. 🧠 Models State-of-the-art models by modality. 💬 Language The major frontier labs. ChatGPT — Best for general reasoning, tool use, and the broadest ecosystem. Claude — Best for long-context analysis, coding, and structured thinking. Gemini — Best for multimodal tasks and Google ecosystem integration. Grok — Best for real-time information via X and very long context. Llama — Best open-weight family for self-hosting and fine-tuning. Mistral — Best for lightweight, high-performance open-weight models. DeepSeek — Best for cost-efficient reasoning with open weights. Qwen — Best for multilingual and Chinese-first applications. Kimi — Best for long-context instruction following. GLM — Frontier-tier Chinese model with open weights. Cohere — Best for enterprise LLMs with strong retrieval-augmented generation APIs. 🖼 Image GPT Image — OpenAI's integrated image generation with near-perfect text rendering. Midjourney — Artistic and photorealistic images. Adobe Firefly — Integrated into Creative Cloud; commercial-safe. Ideogram — Precise, legible text in generated images. Flux — High-res, prompt-editable, open-weight images. 🎥 Video Google Veo — High-quality video with synchronized audio. Runway — Video editing + generation with granular creative control. Kling — Cinematic, realistic video generation. 🎙 Audio ElevenLabs — High-quality text-to-speech and voice cloning. Suno — AI music from text prompts. 📊 Compare Live benchmarks, pricing, and the latest model versions. OpenRouter — Unified API + live pricing across ~300 models. LMArena — Human-preference Elo rankings for text, image, and video. Artificial Analysis — Speed, price, and quality benchmarks across providers. 📡 Follow Stay current without drowning in noise. Newsletters The Rundown AI AlphaSignal Superhuman AI AI Engineer
articles.tldr: GitHub 上 curated 的 AI 工程资源精选列表，涵盖书籍、论文、框架、编码 Agent 和模型。
articles.objective_summary: owainlewis 在 GitHub 上维护了一个精选 AI 工程资源列表（awesome-artificial-intelligence），按类别整理书籍、论文、开发框架、Agent 工具和前沿模型，强调实用性和长期价值。
key_logic_flow: 该列表专注于 AI 工程实践领域（RAG、Agent、评估、护栏、部署），而非纯理论内容。
资源按用途分为现代实用书籍、基础理论书籍、经典论文、开发框架、编码 Agent 工具、前沿模型和媒体生成工具等大类。
作者建议从简单的 LLM 调用开始，逐步升级到复杂框架，而非一开始就使用过多工具链。
覆盖了当前主要的前沿 AI 实验室（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta、Mistral、DeepSeek 等）及其代表性模型。
列表还整理了主流编码 Agent（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Aider 等）及其能力对比基准（SWE-bench、Terminal-Bench）。

impact_score.reason: 这是一个 GitHub Awesome 精选资源列表，本质是社区维护的 AI 工程资源聚合目录。虽然整理得当、分类清晰，但并不包含任何新产品发布、技术突破或商业动态。对行业格局没有实质冲击力，仅对开发者选型有轻微参考价值。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 资源列表的完整性和分类是否覆盖了当前主流 AI 工程工具链

hype_assessment.reason: 文章以平实的 curated 列表形式呈现，未使用任何'颠覆'、'革命性'等 PR 夸大词汇。内容本身就是对已有公开资源的分类汇总，不存在炒作空间。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 无
domain_disruption.business_model: 无

compound_value.reason: 该 Awesome List 是社区驱动的 AI 工程资源精选，在信息过载时代提供了高质量的过滤信号。其长期价值体现在：(1) 聚焦工程实践（RAG、Agent、评估、部署）而非纯理论，具有实用导向；(2) 维护者选品标准较高，推荐内容强调 '五年后仍有价值'；(3) 覆盖生态面广，可作为行业工具图谱参考。但商业复利效应有限：开源列表无排他性、无经济护城河、维护依赖单一个人投入。3-5 年后若维护者失去动力，价值将快速衰减，且任何人都可 fork 出竞争列表。因此评分中等偏低，属于有用但不具备强复利积累的资产。

competitive_casualty: 传统 AI 培训平台
低质量付费资源聚合站点
market_opportunities: 创业者可借鉴该列表'轻量起步、渐进升级'的选型哲学，开发面向中小团队的 AI 工程入门与工具链咨询服务，帮助企业在 RAG/Agent/评估等热点领域快速搭建可行方案
列表中编码 Agent 生态的全面梳理（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Aider 等）表明企业级 Agent 编排与评估平台存在商业化机会，可围绕 SWE-bench/Terminal-Bench 等基准提供跨 Agent 能力对比与选型服务
该列表强调'五年后仍有价值的深度知识'，可考虑构建面向 AI 工程师的系统化学习路径产品，将散落的高质量书籍与论文整合为可跟踪的技能图谱

risk_matrix.regulatory: 列表中涵盖的开源模型（DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM 等）涉及中美 AI 出口管制敏感领域；编码 Agent 工具涉及自动生成代码的著作权与合规风险，企业引入时需评估开源许可合规与跨境数据传输限制
risk_matrix.technological: 列表明确强调'越简单越好'和长期知识，本身已对技术替代风险有所对冲；但框架类资源（LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen 等）迭代极快，半年后部分工具可能被更优方案取代
risk_matrix.competitive: GitHub 上的 Awesome 类列表竞争激烈，本列表的竞争力完全依赖维护者的持续投入与选品眼光，一旦维护放缓则容易被更活跃的竞品列表分流
risk_matrix.ethical: 列表包含大量生成式媒体工具（Midjourney、Runway、ElevenLabs、Suno），涉及深度伪造和版权侵权风险；编码 Agent 自动生成的代码可能引入隐蔽的安全漏洞或后门

articles.title: google-research/timesfm
articles.description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.TimesFM TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting. Paper: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting, ICML 2024. All checkpoints: TimesFM Hugging Face Collection. Google Research blog. TimesFM in Google 1P Products: BigQuery ML: Enterprise level SQL queries for scalability and reliability. Google Sheets: For your daily spreadsheet. Vertex Model Garden: Dockerized endpoint for agentic calling. This open version is not an officially supported Google product. Latest Model Version: TimesFM 2.5 Archived Model Versions: 1.0 and 2.0: relevant code archived in the sub directory v1. You can pip install timesfm==1.3.0 to install an older version of this package to load them. Update - June 5, 2026 Updated PyPI to timesfm=2.0.0. See Install. Update - Apr. 9, 2026 Added fine-tuning example using HuggingFace Transformers + PEFT (LoRA) — see timesfm-forecasting/examples/finetuning/. Also added unit tests (tests/) and incorporated several community fixes. Shoutout to @kashif and @darkpowerxo. Update - Mar. 19, 2026 Huge shoutout to @borealBytes for adding the support for AGENTS! TimesFM SKILL.md is out. Update - Oct. 29, 2025 Added back the covariate support through XReg for TimesFM 2.5. Update - Sept. 15, 2025 TimesFM 2.5 is out! Comparing to TimesFM 2.0, this new 2.5 model: uses 200M parameters, down from 500M. supports up to 16k context length, up from 2048. supports continuous quantile forecast up to 1k horizon via an optional 30M quantile head. gets rid of the frequency indicator. has a couple of new forecasting flags. Since the Sept. 2025 launch, the following improvements have been completed: ✅ Flax version of the model for faster inference. ✅ Covariate support via XReg (see Oct. 2025 update). ✅ Documentation, examples, and agent skill (see timesfm-forecasting/). ✅ Fine-tuning example with LoRA via HuggingFace Transformers + PEFT (see timesfm-forecasting/examples/finetuning/). ✅ Unit tests for core layers, configs, and utilities (see tests/). Install From PyPI # Install the package with torch pip install timesfm[torch] # Or with Flax pip install timesfm[flax] # And when XReg is needed pip install timesfm[xreg] Local Install Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/google-research/timesfm.git cd timesfm Create a virtual environment and install dependencies using uv: # Create a virtual environment uv venv # Activate the environment source .venv/bin/activate # Install the package in editable mode with torch uv pip install -e .[torch] # Or with flax uv pip install -e .[flax] # And when XReg is needed uv pip install -e .[xreg] [Optional] Install your preferred torch / jax backend based on your OS and accelerators (CPU, GPU, TPU or Apple Silicon).: Install PyTorch. Install Jax for Flax. Code Example import torch import numpy as np import timesfm torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high") model = timesfm.TimesFM_2p5_200M_torch.from_pretrained("google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch") model.compile( timesfm.ForecastConfig( max_context=1024, max_horizon=256, normalize_inputs=True, use_continuous_quantile_head=True, force_flip_invariance=True, infer_is_positive=True, fix_quantile_crossing=True, ) ) point_forecast, quantile_forecast = model.forecast( horizon=12, inputs=[ np.linspace(0, 1, 100), np.sin(np.linspace(0, 20, 67)), ], # Two dummy inputs ) point_forecast.shape # (2, 12) quantile_forecast.shape # (2, 12, 10): mean, then 10th to 90th quantiles.
articles.tldr: Google Research 发布 TimesFM 2.5，200M 参数时间序列基础模型，支持 16K 上下文和分位数预测。

key_logic_flow: Google Research 开发了 TimesFM（时间序列基础模型），相关论文被 ICML 2024 收录。
最新版本 TimesFM 2.5 参数量从 2.0 的 500M 降至 200M，上下文长度从 2048 扩展到 16K。
TimesFM 2.5 新增了可选的 30M 分位数头，支持连续分位数预测，预测范围可达 1K。

TimesFM 已集成至 BigQuery ML、Google Sheets 和 Vertex Model Garden 等 Google 产品。
项目新增了 HuggingFace Transformers + PEFT（LoRA）微调示例、单元测试以及 AGENTS 支持（SKILL.md）。

impact_score.reason: TimesFM 2.5 在时间序列基础模型领域实现了显著的效率突破：参数量从500M降至200M（降低60%），上下文长度从2048扩展到16K（8倍提升），同时引入连续分位数预测能力。Google Research 将此模型完全开源且已集成至 BigQuery ML、Vertex Model Garden 等企业级产品，对于时间序列预测行业（金融、供应链、IoT等）具有实质性影响。但时间序列预测属于AI细分领域，影响力不及跨领域范式转移，且该模型自2025年9月已发布，本次是迭代更新而非首发。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 模型体积缩小60%而上下文扩展8倍的技术效率突破，以及LoRA微调示例和AGENTS支持降低了定制化门槛

hype_assessment.reason: 项目描述以具体技术指标（200M参数、16K上下文、30M分位数头）和数据说话，没有使用'颠覆性''革命性'等PR空洞词汇。GitHub仓库提供了完整的安装指南、代码示例、单元测试和微调教程，属于典型的工程化开源项目风格，没有过度包装。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 将时间序列基础模型从500M参数压缩至200M的同时将上下文长度从2048扩展到16K（8倍提升），并引入可选30M分位数头实现连续分位数预测，体现了架构效率的实质性突破；支持PyTorch和Flax双后端，以及XReg协变量支持，增加了工程灵活性。
domain_disruption.business_model: Google通过开源TimesFM降低时间序列预测的入门门槛，同时通过BigQuery ML、Google Sheets和Vertex Model Garden等企业级产品实现商业化变现，形成'开源社区版+企业托管版'的双层商业模式，可能挤压传统时间序列预测SaaS厂商的生存空间。

compound_value.reason: 从 VC 视角评估 TimesFM 2.5 的长期复利价值：(1) 时间序列预测是横跨金融、供应链、能源、IoT、零售的千亿级市场，但长期以来被统计方法（ARIMA、Prophet）和定制深度学习模型主导，缺乏通用基础模型——TimesFM 填补了这一空白，且 ICML 2024 论文验证了 decoder-only 架构在时间序列上的有效性，学术背书降低了技术风险。(2) 200M 参数 + 16K 上下文是关键的差异化卖点：200M 意味着可以在边缘设备、浏览器甚至微控制器上推理，远小于 LLM 类模型；16K 上下文远超竞品（如 Amazon Chronos 的 512 窗口），可捕捉长期季节性模式；这是明显的护城河积累。(3) Google 将其集成至 BigQuery ML、Vertex Model Garden 和 Google Sheets，意味着它已从研究项目走向产品化落地，通过云平台锁定企业客户——这是典型的'开源模型 + 云变现'模式，复利效应在于模型每被企业采用一次，Google Cloud 的粘性就增强一分。(4) 风险点：Google 历史上对开源项目的维护投入不稳定（如 TensorFlow→JAX 的范式切换）；时间序列基础模型赛道正在拥挤化（Nixtla TimeGPT、Salesforce Moirai、Amazon Chronos 都在竞争）；开源本质导致模型本身难以直接定价，价值捕获依赖 Google Cloud 生态而非模型授权。综合评分 7.0：有潜力成为时间序列领域的通用基础层，但需要在生态锁定和持续迭代上证明自己，3-5 年后可能成为 Google Cloud 数据分析栈的重要拼图，而非独立的创收单元。

competitive_casualty: 传统时序预测 SaaS 厂商
封闭源代码时序模型创业公司
纯统计方法工具商
market_opportunities: 基于 TimesFM 2.5 的 200M 轻量级架构和 LoRA 微调支持，企业可低成本构建金融、能源、供应链等垂直领域的时间序列预测方案
TimesFM 已集成至 BigQuery ML、Vertex AI 和 Google Sheets，GCP 生态用户可快速将时间序列预测能力嵌入现有数据分析与决策工作流
16K 上下文长度和连续分位数预测能力，适用于高频交易预测、长期气候建模和库存规划等需要长历史窗口及不确定性量化的场景

risk_matrix.regulatory: 该模型以 Apache 2.0 风格开源发布，无直接监管风险。但若用于金融预测等受监管领域，需注意模型可解释性和合规审计要求
risk_matrix.technological: 时间序列基础模型赛道竞争激烈（AWS Chronos、Salesforce Moirai、Lag-Llama 等），Google 的架构优势可能被快速追赶；模型从 500M 压缩至 200M 可能在某些复杂场景下牺牲精度
risk_matrix.competitive: Google 将 TimesFM 集成至 BigQuery ML/Vertex AI/Sheets 形成 GCP 生态锁定效应，对第三方独立预测服务商构成挤压；但强依赖 Google 生态也存在平台迁移风险
risk_matrix.ethical: 时间序列模型的预测错误在金融交易、能源调度、灾害预警等关键场景可能造成重大损失；历史数据中的结构性偏差可能被模型固化，导致系统性预测偏移

articles.title: makeplane/plane
articles.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage. Modern project management for all teams Website • Forum • X • Documentation Meet Plane, an open-source project management tool to track issues, run ~sprints~ cycles, and manage product roadmaps without the chaos of managing the tool itself. 🧘‍♀️ Plane is evolving every day. Your suggestions, ideas, and reported bugs help us immensely. Do not hesitate to join in the conversation on Forum or raise a GitHub issue. We read everything and respond to most. 🚀 Installation Getting started with Plane is simple. Choose the setup that works best for you: Plane Cloud Sign up for a free account on Plane Cloud—it's the fastest way to get up and running without worrying about infrastructure. Self-host Plane Prefer full control over your data and infrastructure? Install and run Plane on your own servers. Follow our detailed deployment guides to get started. Installation methods Docs link Docker Kubernetes Instance admins can configure instance settings with God mode. 🌟 Features Work Items Efficiently create and manage tasks with a robust rich text editor that supports file uploads. Enhance organization and tracking by adding sub-properties and referencing related issues. Cycles Maintain your team’s momentum with Cycles. Track progress effortlessly using burn-down charts and other insightful tools. Modules Simplify complex projects by dividing them into smaller, manageable modules. Views Customize your workflow by creating filters to display only the most relevant issues. Save and share these views with ease. Pages Capture and organize ideas using Plane Pages, complete with AI capabilities and a rich text editor. Format text, insert images, add hyperlinks, or convert your notes into actionable items. Analytics Access real-time insights across all your Plane data. Visualize trends, remove blockers, and keep your projects moving forward. 🛠️ Local development See CONTRIBUTING ⚙️ Built with 📸 Screenshots 📝 Documentation Explore Plane's product documentation and developer documentation to learn about features, setup, and usage. ❤️ Community Join the Plane community on GitHub Discussions and our Forum. We follow a Code of conduct in all our community channels. Feel free to ask questions, report bugs, participate in discussions, share ideas, request features, or showcase your projects. We’d love to hear from you! 🛡️ Security If you discover a security vulnerability in Plane, please report it responsibly instead of opening a public issue. We take all legitimate reports seriously and will investigate them promptly. See Security policy for more info. To disclose any security issues, please email us at security@plane.so. 🤝 Contributing There are many ways you can contribute to Plane: Report bugs or submit feature requests. Review the documentation and submit pull requests to improve it—whether it's fixing typos or adding new content. Talk or write about Plane or any other ecosystem integration and let us know! Show your support by upvoting popular feature requests. Please read CONTRIBUTING.md for details on the process for submitting pull requests to us. Repo activity We couldn't have done this without you. License This project is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0.
articles.tldr: Plane 是一个开源项目管理工具，支持问题跟踪、周期管理和路线图规划。
articles.objective_summary: makeplane 在 GitHub 上发布 Plane，一个开源项目管理工具，提供云服务和自托管两种部署方式，核心功能包括工作项管理、周期、模块、自定义视图、AI 辅助页面和分析仪表盘，采用 AGPL v3.0 协议。
key_logic_flow: Plane 是一个开源项目管理工具，核心用途是跟踪问题、管理周期（Cycles）和产品路线图。
Plane 提供两种部署方式：Plane Cloud 云服务（免费注册）和自托管部署（支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes）。
Plane 的核心功能包括工作项管理（支持富文本编辑器和文件上传）、周期与燃尽图、模块化项目拆分、自定义筛选视图、AI 辅助页面（Pages）以及实时分析仪表盘。
Plane 托管在 GitHub 上，采用 GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 开源协议。
Plane 通过 GitHub Discussions 和官方论坛鼓励社区参与，支持报告 bug、提交功能请求和改进文档等贡献方式。

impact_score.reason: Plane 是一个开源项目管理工具，并非 AI 行业特定事件。该评分基于以下维度：1) 项目管理赛道高度拥挤（Jira、Linear、Asana、ClickUp、OpenProject 等），Plane 作为后来者短期难以撼动格局；2) 该项目已在 GitHub 上活跃一段时间，本次仅为项目 README 展示而非重大版本发布或融资事件；3) 尽管提到 AI 辅助 Pages，但这并非核心技术突破，属于锦上添花功能。综合判断属于日常更新级别的行业影响。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 开源替代 Linear/Jira 的可行性和自托管能力

hype_assessment.reason: 项目 README 使用'Modern project management'等合理表述描述产品定位，功能列表（工作项、周期、模块、视图、分析仪表盘）均为业界标准功能术语，没有出现'颠覆'、'革命性'、'首创'等 PR 滥用词汇。整体风格务实客观，无过度包装痕迹。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 无
domain_disruption.business_model: 开源双轨模式（免费云服务 + Docker/Kubernetes 自托管）对传统项目管理 SaaS（Jira、Linear）形成替代压力，尤其对注重数据隐私、预算控制和定制化需求的中小团队有吸引力。采用 AGPL v3.0 协议，延续了开源软件对商业闭源产品的竞争策略。

compound_value.reason: Plane 是一款设计精良的开源项目管理工具，在 Linear 风格 UI + 自托管 + AGPL 强开源协议的组合上形成了差异化定位。从 VC 视角看，其长期复利价值处于中等水平：正面因素包括项目管理市场 TAM 巨大（每支团队都需要）、自托管方案满足企业数据主权刚需、开源社区能持续贡献降低研发成本；但负面因素同样显著——用户切换成本低、缺乏强网络效应（PM 工具的使用粘性来自流程固化而非数据网络）、与 Linear/Jira/Asana 等资金充裕的竞品直接竞争、AGPL 协议虽保护自身云业务但会阻碍部分企业自托管采纳。AI Pages 功能是加分项但并非护城河。综合判断，Plane 有潜力成为自托管 PM 赛道的细分基础设施，但需要在商业化变现（Cloud 付费转化率）和社区护城河建设上持续验证。3-5 年后能否成为行业基石存在不确定性。

key_beneficiaries: 自托管基础设施提供商（Docker、Kubernetes 生态）
寻求 Linear/Jira 替代方案的中小团队
competitive_casualty: Linear（UI/UX 对标，开源差异化稀释其高端定位）
Jira（长尾客户流失至免费自托管方案）
ClickUp、Asana（SaaS PM 中低端市场受压）
Taiga、OpenProject 等老牌开源 PM 工具（社区注意力被 Plane 分流）
market_opportunities: 企业可采用 Plane 自托管方案替代 Jira/Linear，在降低许可证成本的同时获得数据主权，尤其适用于金融、政务等受数据合规管控的行业
Plane 的 AI 辅助 Pages 功能为开发者提供了集成 AI 能力到项目管理流程的切入点，可围绕智能任务拆解、自动燃尽图预测等场景开发插件或增值服务
开源社区可围绕 Plane 的 AGPL v3.0 生态构建定制化主题、工作流模板和第三方集成市场，服务于垂直行业（如游戏开发、硬件项目）的差异化需求

risk_matrix.regulatory: AGPL v3.0 许可要求分发修改版时的源代码开放，对某些闭源商业集成场景构成合规约束；若 Plane 用于受监管行业（如医疗、金融）的关键项目管理流程，需额外评估数据驻留和审计日志要求
risk_matrix.technological: 项目管理赛道技术壁垒较低，功能差异化空间有限；Plane 尚未建立显著的架构护城河，新兴工具（如基于 AI Agent 的自主项目管理）可能在 2-3 年内形成替代威胁
risk_matrix.competitive: 面临 Linear（开发者体验领先）、Jira（企业生态深厚）、Notion（文档+项目管理融合）、OpenProject（开源替代成熟）等多维度竞争，Plane 需在 AI 功能和社区生态上持续投入才能维持增长
risk_matrix.ethical: 无

articles.title: zai-org/GLM-5
articles.description: GLM-5: From Vibe Coding to Agentic EngineeringGLM-5.2 & GLM-5.1 & GLM-5 👋 Join our Wechat or Discord community. 📖 Check out the GLM-5.2 blog and GLM-5 Technical report. 📍 Use GLM-5.2 API services on Z.ai API Platform. 🔜 Try GLM-5.2 at z.ai. Introduction GLM-5.2 GLM-5.2, our latest flagship model for long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and, for the first time, delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. GLM-5.2's new capabilities include: Solid 1M Context: A solid 1M-token context that stably sustains long-horizon work Advanced Coding with Flexible Effort: Stronger coding capabilities with multiple thinking effort levels to balance performance and latency Improved Architecture: We propose IndexShare, which reuses the same indexer across every four sparse attention layers, reducing per-token FLOPs by 2.9× at a 1M context length. We also improve GLM-5.2’s MTP layer for speculative decoding, increasing the acceptance length by up to 20% On standard coding benchmarks, GLM-5.2 is the strongest open-source model, improving on GLM-5.1 by a wide margin: 81.0 vs. 62.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 62.1 vs. 58.4 on SWE-bench Pro. It also closes much of the gap to the closed-source frontier — on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (81.0) it lands within a few points of Claude Opus 4.8 (85.0) — while staying ahead of Gemini 3.1 Pro. For more detail, check our blog. GLM-5.1 GLM-5.1 is our next-generation flagship model for agentic engineering, with significantly stronger coding capabilities than its predecessor. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench Pro and leads GLM-5 by a wide margin on NL2Repo (repo generation) and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (real-world terminal tasks). But the most meaningful leap goes beyond first-pass performance. Previous models—including GLM-5—tend to exhaust their repertoire early: they apply familiar techniques for quick initial gains, then plateau. Giving them more time doesn't help. GLM-5.1, by contrast, is built to stay effective on agentic tasks over much longer horizons. We've found that the model handles ambiguous problems with better judgment and stays productive over longer sessions. It breaks complex problems down, runs experiments, reads results, and identifies blockers with real precision. By revisiting its reasoning and revising its strategy through repeated iteration, GLM-5.1 sustains optimization over hundreds of rounds and thousands of tool calls. The longer it runs, the better the result. GLM-5 We are launching GLM-5, targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks. Scaling is still one of the most important ways to improve the intelligence efficiency of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Compared to GLM-4.5, GLM-5 scales from 355B parameters (32B active) to 744B parameters (40B active), and increases pre-training data from 23T to 28.5T tokens. GLM-5 also integrates DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), largely reducing deployment cost while preserving long-context capacity. Reinforcement learning aims to bridge the gap between competence and excellence in pre-trained models. However, deploying it at scale for LLMs is a challenge due to the RL training inefficiency. To this end, we developed slime, a novel asynchronous RL infrastructure that substantially improves training throughput and efficiency, enabling more fine-grained post-training iterations. With advances in both pre-training and post-training, GLM-5 delivers significant improvement compared to GLM-4.7 across a wide range of academic benchmarks and achieves best-in-class performance among all open-source models in the world on reasoning, coding, and agentic tasks, closing the gap with frontier models. GLM-5 is purpose-built for complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks. On our internal evaluation suite CC-Bench-V2, GLM-5 significantly outperforms GLM-4.7 across frontend, backend, and long-horizon tasks, narrowing the gap to Claude Opus 4.5. On Vending Bench 2, a benchmark that measures long-term operational capability, GLM-5 ranks #1 among open-source models. Vending Bench 2 requires the model to run a simulated vending machine business over a one-year horizon; GLM-5 finishes with a final account balance of $4,432, approaching Claude Opus 4.5 and demonstrating strong long-term planning and resource management. Download Model Model Download Links Model Size Precision GLM-5.2 🤗 Hugging Face 🤖 ModelScope 744B-A40B BF16 GLM-5.2-FP8 🤗 Hugging Face 🤖 ModelScope 744B-A40B FP8 GLM-5.1 🤗 Hugging Face 🤖 ModelScope 744B-A40B BF16 GLM-5.1-FP8 🤗 Hugging Face 🤖 ModelScope 744B-A40B FP8 GLM-5 🤗 Hugging Face 🤖 ModelScope 744B-A40B BF16 GLM-5-FP8 🤗 Hugging Face 🤖 ModelScope 744B-A40B FP8 Serve GLM-5 Series Locally GLM-5.2 supports deployment with the following frameworks. Feel free to try them out: SGLang (v0.5.13.post1+) — see cookbook vLLM (v0.23.0+) — see recipes Transformers (v0.5.12+) — see transformers docs KTransformers (v0.5.12+) — see tutorial For deployment on the Ascend NPU platform, inference frameworks such as vLLM-Ascend, xLLM and SGLang are supported — see here. GLM-5 supports controlling the thinking budget through the reasoning_effort parameter, which accepts two levels: max and high. max is the default — if reasoning_effort is left unset (or set to any value other than high), the model runs at Max. To use the High level, you must explicitly pass reasoning_effort="high". For default scenarios such as benchmark/leaderboard reproduction, keep Max (no setting required); only set reasoning_effort="high" when you specifically want the High level. Thinking can be turned off entirely by setting enable_thinking=false. articles.tldr: 智谱AI发布GLM-5系列旗舰模型，支持百万token上下文和强编码能力
articles.objective_summary: 智谱AI（zai-org）发布GLM-5、GLM-5.1、GLM-5.2三代模型。GLM-5.2支持100万token稳定上下文，采用IndexShare架构将长上下文计算量降低2.9倍，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上得分81.0，逼近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0）。
key_logic_flow: 智谱AI发布GLM-5系列三代模型（GLM-5、GLM-5.1、GLM-5.2），定位复杂系统工程和长周期智能体任务。
GLM-5.2首次实现稳定的100万token上下文窗口，并支持可调节思考强度的编码能力（Max/High两档）。
GLM-5.2采用IndexShare架构，每四层稀疏注意力共享同一索引器，在100万上下文下将单token FLOPs降低2.9倍。
GLM-5.2在Terminal-Bench 2.1上得分81.0，大幅领先GLM-5.1（62.0），接近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0），超越Gemini 3.1 Pro。
GLM-5.1擅长长周期智能体任务，能在数百轮交互和数千次工具调用中持续优化策略，SWE-Bench Pro和Vending Bench 2上达到开源模型最佳水平。
GLM-5拥有7440亿参数（400亿活跃参数），集成DeepSeek Sparse Attention，并开发异步强化学习基础设施SLiME以提升后训练效率。

impact_score.reason: 智谱AI一次性发布GLM-5/5.1/5.2三代模型，744B参数（40B活跃）的开源MoE模型在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到81.0分，逼近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0），超越Gemini 3.1 Pro，这是开源模型在agentic编码任务上对闭源前沿最有力的追赶之一。但模型并未实现超越，且智谱在开源社区的全球影响力仍弱于DeepSeek、Meta等玩家，属于重要的局部竞争格局变化（尤其在中国市场和开源社区），而非行业范式转移。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 开源模型在编码和agentic任务上能否复现宣称的基准测试成绩

hype_assessment.reason: 文章提供了具体的架构创新（IndexShare、SLiME）、详尽的基准测试对比和部署框架支持列表，技术含量扎实。但'closing the gap to frontier'、'best-in-class among all open-source models'属于标准PR话术，Terminal-Bench和Vending Bench等自建基准的权威性尚待第三方验证，存在一定包装成分。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: IndexShare架构通过每四层稀疏注意力共享同一索引器，在100万token上下文下将单token FLOPs降低2.9倍，是对长上下文推理效率的实质性工程优化；异步强化学习框架SLiME提升了后训练吞吐量，使更细粒度的迭代成为可能。
domain_disruption.business_model: 开源744B参数模型在编码和agentic任务上逼近GPT/Claude闭源前沿，可能加速中国企业降低对美国AI模型供应商的技术依赖，同时推动AI应用从'聊天式'向'长周期自主agent'方向演进，重塑企业对AI模型的选型标准和部署模式。

compound_value.reason: GLM-5系列在技术上取得了真实进步：IndexShare架构将长上下文计算量降低2.9倍、实现稳定百万token上下文、Terminal-Bench 81.0逼近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0），这些都是有工程价值的创新。但从VC视角看，开放权重模型赛道已高度拥挤（DeepSeek、Qwen、Llama、Mistral群雄并立），模型本身作为商品的正反馈效应有限。GLM-5的开源策略意味着商业变现主要依赖API平台（z.ai），而非模型权重本身。SLiME异步RL基础设施和IndexShare架构是稀缺的技术资产，可能为智谱在Agent长周期任务场景建立差异化，但其长期复利取决于能否将技术领先转化为开发者生态和API收入飞轮，而非模型权重分发。整体评估：有真实技术价值但处于激烈红海，复利效应中等偏上。需要持续观察后续模型迭代速度和API商业化进展。评分6.5反映了'值得跟踪但不下重注'的VC判断。

competitive_casualty: OpenAI
Anthropic
Google DeepMind
其他中小型中国AI模型厂商
market_opportunities: 企业可基于GLM-5.2的百万token上下文窗口，构建面向大型代码仓库和复杂系统工程的全量代码理解与重构工具，替代多次切片+拼接的传统方案
创业者可利用GLM-5.1的长周期智能体能力，开发自动化运维和DevOps智能体产品，在数百轮交互中持续优化部署策略和故障排查
开源特性（HuggingFace/ModelScope可下载）为中小团队提供了低成本接入前沿模型的路径，可聚焦垂直行业的微调部署和私有化服务

risk_matrix.regulatory: GLM系列由中国企业（智谱AI）开发，在欧美市场部署可能面临地缘政治相关的出口管制或数据合规审查（如AI Act高风险分类体系下的合规成本）；开源模型的许可证条款需仔细审查以避免商用风险
risk_matrix.technological: IndexShare架构虽降低2.9倍FLOPs，但DeepSeek Sparse Attention等竞品已有类似稀疏注意力方案，技术独特性有待验证；长上下文真实生产环境中的检索精度和幻觉控制能力仍需独立评测确认
risk_matrix.competitive: DeepSeek、Claude Opus、Gemini等均在大规模编码和智能体赛道激烈竞争，开源大模型（744B参数级别）日益商品化，差异化窗口可能收窄；Terminal-Bench 2.1得分81.0虽接近Claude Opus 4.8（85.0）但仍有差距
risk_matrix.ethical: 7440亿参数的超大规模模型训练和推理带来显著能源消耗与环境影响；强编码与智能体能力可能被用于自动化攻击开发和漏洞利用等恶意用途

articles.title: withastro/flue
articles.description: The sandbox agent framework.Flue — The Agent Harness Framework Not another SDK. Build autonomous agents and powerful AI workflows with Flue's programmable TypeScript harness. // agents/triage.ts import { createAgent, type AgentRouteHandler } from '@flue/runtime'; import { local } from '@flue/runtime/node'; import triage from '../skills/triage/SKILL.md' with { type: 'skill' }; import verify from '../skills/verify/SKILL.md' with { type: 'skill' }; import * as githubTools from '../tools/github.ts'; // Give agents the context and autonomy to solve complex tasks: const instructions = ` Triage a bug report end-to-end: reproduce the bug, diagnose the root cause, verify whether the behavior is intentional, and attempt a fix. ...`; // Expose (and protect) your agents over HTTP: export const route: AgentRouteHandler = async (_c, next) => next(); // Compose the complete harness your agent needs to do real work, // complete with virtual, local, or remote container sandbox. export default createAgent(() => ({ model: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6', tools: [...githubTools], skills: [triage, verify], sandbox: local(), instructions, })); The framework for building the next generation of agents. The first agents were built with raw LLM API calls. This worked for simple chatbots and scripted tasks, but not much else. Agents like Claude Code and Codex broke the mold. These were real agents. Autonomous. You give them a task — not a pre-defined series of steps — and trust them to complete it using the context and tools that you provide. Flue unlocks this new architecture for agents. Its built-in TypeScript harness gives any model the context and environment it needs for truly autonomous work: sessions, tools, skills, instructions, filesystem access, and a secure sandbox to run in. Run your agents locally via CLI or deploy them to your hosted runtime of choice. Features Build agents that can safely take action, maintain continuity, and connect to the systems where work already happens. Agents — Build agents that can keep context across conversations and events as they autonomously work toward a goal. Workflows — Run structured automations where your code guides agent reasoning from a clear input to a finished result. Sandboxes — Give agents a secure environment where they can use tools, modify files, and autonomously complete real work. Durable Execution — Learn how agents preserve progress through failures and restarts with durable recovery for accepted work. Subagents — Define specialized roles for different tasks, then let your agent delegate work to the right expert. Tools — Give agents typed actions for calling APIs, querying data, and making controlled changes through your application. Skills — Package reusable expertise and workflows that agents can load whenever a task needs specialized guidance. MCP Servers — Connect agents to authenticated tools and services through the open Model Context Protocol ecosystem. Observability — Monitor your agents and export telemetry with OpenTelemetry, Braintrust, Sentry, or your own observer. Channels — Receive verified events from Slack, Teams, Discord, GitHub, and more. Deploy Anywhere Node.js Cloudflare Workers GitHub Actions GitLab CI/CD Daytona Render Packages Package Description @flue/runtime Runtime: harness, sessions, tools, sandbox @flue/cli CLI and build/dev tooling (flue binary) @flue/sdk Client SDK for consuming deployed agents and workflows @flue/opentelemetry OpenTelemetry tracing adapter @flue/postgres Postgres persistence adapter
articles.tldr: Astro 发布 Flue，一个可编程 TypeScript 运行时框架，用于构建自主 AI Agent 和工作流。
articles.objective_summary: Astro (withastro) 发布了 Flue 开源项目，这是一个 TypeScript 可编程运行时框架，用于构建自主 AI Agent 和工作流。Flue 提供会话管理、工具调用、技能加载、沙箱安全执行和持久化执行等能力，支持本地 CLI 运行或远程部署，并集成 MCP 协议和
key_logic_flow: Flue 是 Astro 发布的 TypeScript 开源框架，旨在用于构建自主 AI Agent 和可编程工作流，而不是传统的 SDK 模式。
Flue 的核心设计理念是让开发者构建可自主行动的 Agent——只需给出任务目标而非预定义步骤，Agent 利用上下文和工具自主完成任务。
Flue 提供完整的运行时能力：会话管理、工具调用、技能加载、文件系统访问、沙箱安全执行环境和持久化执行恢复。
Flue 支持通过 HTTP 路由暴露 Agent，支持本地 CLI 运行或部署到远程托管运行时，并内置子 Agent 委派机制。
Flue 的生态集成包括 MCP Server、OpenTelemetry 可观测性适配、Postgres 持久化适配，以及 Slack、Teams、Discord、GitHub 等渠道的事件接收。
Flue 提供四个核心包：@flue/runtime（运行时核心）、@flue/cli（CLI 工具）、@flue/sdk（客户端 SDK）和 @flue/opentelemetry（可观测性适配器）。

impact_score.reason: Astro 团队凭借前端框架领域的极高声誉和开发者信任度进入 AI Agent 框架赛道，其 'Not another SDK' 的定位和可编程 TypeScript Harness 架构具有明确的差异化策略。技能模块导入(import with { type: 'skill' })和内置沙箱等设计显示出对开发者体验的深度思考。然而，当前 AI Agent 框架市场已高度拥挤——LangChain、CrewAI、Vercel AI SDK、AutoGPT 等均已建立各自的生态位。Flue 作为新入场者尚未证明其生态吸引力和规模化能力，短期行业关注度会显著提升但不足以引发范式转移。评分基于：中等冲击力（重要产品发布 + 品牌信誉加持），但赛道拥挤限制了上层空间。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: Flue 的'可编程 Harness'架构与 LangChain/Vercel AI SDK 等现有方案的实际开发体验差异及自主 Agent 能力上限

hype_assessment.reason: 项目 README 以具体技术描述为主，未使用'颠覆'、'革命性'、'重塑'等 PR 滥用词汇。'Not another SDK' 是明确的定位陈述而非空洞口号。代码示例、架构设计（4 个核心包）、功能清单（会话管理、工具调用、沙箱安全执行、持久化恢复、MCP 集成、OpenTelemetry 可观测性）均为可验证的技术能力，无概念包装痕迹。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 提出 TypeScript 可编程 Harness 架构替代传统 SDK 模式，以 'createAgent() + 技能模块导入(import ... with { type: "skill" }) + 沙箱安全执行' 三元组原语替代主流 Agent 框架的链式编排/图工作流范式。技能以 Markdown 文件作为一等模块导入的设计，本质是将 Prompt Engineering 提升为类型安全的语言级抽象，具有工程实践上的创新性。
domain_disruption.business_model: Astro 将其前端框架的生态建设经验（开源+插件系统+集成市场）延伸至 AI Agent 领域。若 Flue 走相似路径，可能催生围绕 Agent 技能(Skills)、工具(Tools)和 MCP Server 集成的开发者市场生态，进而影响 AI 工作流工具链的商业格局——从单一的 API 调用收费转向组件市场和托管运行时服务。

compound_value.reason: Flue 定位为 TypeScript 原生的自主 Agent 运行时框架，而非传统 SDK，这一设计理念切中了当前 Agent 开发的核心痛点：开发者需要的是能自主决策的运行时环境（会话管理、沙箱安全、持久化执行），而非单纯的大模型 API 封装。Astro 团队在开发者工具领域拥有良好品牌信誉和社区信任（Astro 框架已验证其交付能力），这是早期项目最稀缺的资产。Flue 的开源策略 + MCP 协议原生集成 + TypeScript 生态切入，有望在 Web 开发者群体中快速形成采用。但该赛道极其拥挤：LangChain 已建立 Python 生态护城河，Vercel AI SDK 依托 Vercel 云平台优势，CrewAI 在多 Agent 协作领域先发。Flue 的长期复利取决于两个关键变量：(1)能否在 6-12 个月内形成显著的开发者社区和技能/工具生态；(2)Astro 团队是否有足够资本支持持续投入，避免被大厂同质化竞争碾压。目前处于早期破局阶段，潜力与风险并存，建议密切关注开发者 adoption 速度。

competitive_casualty: LangChain
Vercel AI SDK
CrewAI
传统 RPA 厂商
market_opportunities: 开发者可基于 Flue 构建垂直行业的自主 Agent，如自动化代码审查、DevOps 故障排查、安全事件响应等场景，利用其沙箱安全执行和工具调用能力替代人工操作
Flue 的 Skill 包机制和 MCP 集成开辟了 Agent 技能/工具市场机会，开发者可封装领域专业知识为可复用技能包，形成生态变现渠道
企业级工作流自动化场景（如 CI/CD 流水线、客户支持工单处理）可借助 Flue 的持久化执行和子 Agent 委派能力，构建高可靠性的 AI 自动化管线

risk_matrix.regulatory: 自主 Agent 的决策行为可能引发合规责任归属问题，尤其是金融、医疗等强监管行业——当 Agent 自主执行操作造成损失时，责任界定尚不清晰。需关注各司法管辖区对 AI Agent 行为的监管动态
risk_matrix.technological: Agent 框架赛道已十分拥挤：Vercel AI SDK、LangChain/LangGraph、CrewAI 等竞品已建立先发优势。Flue 作为新入场者，面临生态成熟度不足和开发者认知门槛的双重挑战
risk_matrix.competitive: Astro 的核心品牌认知在 Web 框架而非 AI Agent 领域，可能面临开发者信任度不足的问题。Vercel 等竞争对手已拥有深厚的 AI 工具链和开发者社区，Flue 需要在差异化定位上持续发力
risk_matrix.ethical: 自主 Agent 获取工具调用和文件系统访问权限后，若指令不够精确或安全边界配置不当，可能导致非预期的破坏性操作。沙箱逃逸风险和数据隐私泄露是需要重点防范的伦理隐患

articles.title: yifanfeng97/Hyper-Extract
articles.description: Transform unstructured text into structured knowledge with LLMs. Graphs, hypergraphs, and spatio-temporal extractions — with one command. Smart Knowledge Extraction CLI Transform documents into structured knowledge with one command. 📖 English Version · 中文版 "Stop reading. Start understanding." "告别文档焦虑，让信息一目了然" Hyper-Extract is an intelligent, LLM-powered knowledge extraction and evolution framework. It radically simplifies transforming highly unstructured texts into persistent, predictable, and strongly-typed Knowledge Abstracts. It effortlessly extracts information into a wide spectrum of formats—ranging from simple Collections (Lists/Sets) and Pydantic Models, to complex Knowledge Graphs, Hypergraphs, and even Spatio-Temporal Graphs. ✨ Core Features 🔷 8 Knowledge Structures From simple Lists to advanced Graphs, Hypergraphs, and Spatio-Temporal Graphs 🧠 10+ Extraction Engines GraphRAG, LightRAG, Hyper-RAG, KG-Gen, and more — ready to use 📝 80+ YAML Templates Zero-code extraction across Finance, Legal, Medical, TCM, Industry, and General domains 🔄 Incremental Evolution Feed new documents anytime to expand and refine your knowledge base 🎯 What Can You Do With It? 📄 Researcher — Turn papers into knowledge graphs Feed a 20-page academic paper, get an interactive graph of key concepts, authors, and citations. he parse paper.pdf -t general/academic_graph -o ./paper_kb/ he show ./paper_kb/ 🏦 Financial Analyst — Extract entities from earnings reports Automatically identify companies, executives, financial metrics, and their relationships from unstructured reports. he parse earnings.md -t finance/earnings_graph -o ./finance_kb/ he search ./finance_kb/ "What are the key risk factors?" 🔒 Local Deployment — Keep data on-premise with vLLM Run Qwen3.5-9B + bge-m3 locally via vLLM. No data leaves your machine. from hyperextract import create_client llm, emb = create_client( llm="vllm:Qwen3.5-9B@http://localhost:8000/v1", embedder="vllm:bge-m3@http://localhost:8001/v1", api_key="dummy", ) 🚀 Supported Platforms & Models Hyper-Extract relies on the LLM's structured output capability (json_schema or Function Calling). Platform Verified Models OpenAI gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-5 阿里云百炼 qwen-plus, qwen-turbo, deepseek-r1 Local vLLM Qwen3.5-9B (GPTQ-Marlin) Embedding models (semantic search) work with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-v4 (Bailian), bge-m3 (local vLLM). 📖 Full guide: Provider System & Local Model Support ⚡ 30-Second Quick Start # Install uv tool install hyperextract # Configure API key he config init -k YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY # Extract knowledge from a document he parse examples/en/tesla.md -t general/biography_graph -o ./output/ -l en # Query it he search ./output/ "What are Tesla's major achievements?" # Visualize he show ./output/ 🐍 Python API (click to expand) uv pip install hyperextract from hyperextract import Template ka = Template.create("general/biography_graph") with open("examples/en/tesla.md") as f: result = ka.parse(f.read()) result.show() 🔗 More examples: examples/en 📈 Why Hyper-Extract? Feature GraphRAG LightRAG KG-Gen ATOM Hyper-Extract Knowledge Graph ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ Temporal Graph ✅ ❌ ❌ ✅ ✅ Spatial Graph ❌ ❌ ❌ ❌ ✅ Hypergraph ❌ ❌ ❌ ❌ ✅ Domain Templates ❌ ❌ ❌ ❌ ✅ Interactive CLI ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ ✅ Multi-language ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ ✅ 🧩 Supported Knowledge Structures From simple to complex — pick the right structure for your data: Example — AutoGraph visualization: 📋 What's under the hood? (Architecture & Templates) Hyper-Extract follows a three-layer architecture: Auto-Types — 8 strongly-typed data structures (Model, List, Set, Graph, Hypergraph, Temporal Graph, Spatial Graph, Spatio-Temporal Graph) Methods — Extraction algorithms: KG-Gen, GraphRAG, LightRAG, Hyper-RAG, Cog-RAG, and more Templates — 80+ presets across 6 domains. articles.tldr: Hyper-Extract：基于LLM的命令行知识提取框架，支持8种知识结构和MCP协议
articles.objective_summary: yifanfeng97 发布了开源项目 Hyper-Extract，一个基于 LLM 的知识提取与演化框架，支持将非结构化文本转为知识图谱、超图、时空图等 8 种结构化格式，提供 CLI 工具和 MCP Server，已内置 80+ YAML 模板和 10+ 提取引擎。
key_logic_flow: Hyper-Extract 是一个基于 LLM 结构化输出能力的知识提取 CLI 工具，支持 OpenAI GPT、Anthropic Claude、阿里云百炼 Qwen 及本地 vLLM 等多种模型后端。
该框架提供 8 种强类型知识结构（Model、List、Set、Graph、Hypergraph、Temporal Graph、Spatial Graph、Spatio-Temporal Graph）和 10 多种提取算法引擎（GraphRAG、LightRAG、KG-Gen、Hyper-RAG 等）。
内置 80+ 跨领域 YAML 模板（金融、法律、医疗、中医、工业、通用），用户无需编码即可实现零代码知识提取。
支持增量演化：用户可持续投喂新文档，对已有知识库进行扩展和精炼。
提供 MCP Server（he-mcp）和 Obsidian 导出功能，可将提取的图谱转为 Markdown 笔记并以 [[wikilinks]] 链接组织。
项目采用三层架构（Auto-Types 数据结构层、Methods 提取算法层、Templates 模板预设层），采用 Apache-2.0 开源协议。

impact_score.reason: Hyper-Extract 是一个有实用价值的开源工具，将 GraphRAG、LightRAG、KG-Gen 等多种知识提取方法整合到统一的 CLI 框架中，并提供 80+ 预置模板降低使用门槛。但它本质上是现有方法的系统性封装和工程化落地，并非底层算法或范式层面的突破。对于 RAG/知识图谱领域的开发者有一定吸引力，但不足以改变行业竞争格局或引发范式转移。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 零代码知识提取的实用性和模板丰富度，以及 MCP 协议支持带来的 AI IDE 集成潜力

hype_assessment.reason: 项目 README 使用了 'Stop reading. Start understanding'、'Smart Knowledge Extraction CLI' 等营销话术，对比表中强调自身功能覆盖优势，存在一定程度的包装。但项目本身是开源（Apache-2.0）、有完整架构文档、可实际安装运行的代码，并非空概念。80+ 模板和 10+ 引擎是真实功能，水分主要在于营销话术而非虚假宣传。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 无底层算法突破，主要贡献在于工程整合：三层架构（Auto-Types 数据结构层/Methods 提取算法层/Templates 模板预设层）将 8 种知识结构、10+ 提取算法和 80+ 跨领域模板统一在 CLI 工具下，用户无需编码即可完成从文档到结构化知识的端到端提取。支持 MCP 协议是亮点，使其可被 Claude Desktop 等 AI 助手直接调用。
domain_disruption.business_model: 无。Apache-2.0 开源项目，不涉及商业模式重塑。

compound_value.reason: Hyper-Extract 定位于 LLM 知识提取中间件层，核心价值在于将非结构化文本一键转为知识图谱/超图等 8 种结构化格式，并原生支持 MCP 协议。从长期复利角度看：(1) MCP Server 集成（he-mcp）使其成为 AI Agent 生态的基础设施组件，随着 Claude Desktop 和 IDE Agent 对 MCP 的依赖加深，该项目的网络效应和粘性会持续增强；(2) 80+ YAML 模板和 10+ 提取引擎构成了先发的内容壁垒，增量演化机制让用户数据资产不断沉淀；(3) 但作为 Apache-2.0 开源的个人项目，缺乏商业化闭环和公司级支持，长期存续性和迭代速度存在不确定性。综合判断：有潜力成为 RAG/知识图谱赛道的标配工具层，但独立构建商业护城河面临挑战，评分 6.5。

articles.title: Lightricks/LTX-2
articles.description: Official Python inference and LoRA trainer package for the LTX-2 audio–video generative model.LTX-2 LTX-2 is the first DiT-based audio-video foundation model that contains all core capabilities of modern video generation in one model: synchronized audio and video, high fidelity, multiple performance modes, production-ready outputs, API access, and open access. 🚀 Quick Start # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2.git cd LTX-2 # Set up the environment uv sync --frozen source .venv/bin/activate Required Models Download the following models from the LTX-2.3 HuggingFace repository: LTX-2.3 Model Checkpoint (choose and download one of the following) ltx-2.3-22b-dev.safetensors - Download ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1.safetensors - Download Spatial Upscaler - Required for current two-stage pipeline implementations in this repository ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors - Download ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x1.5-1.0.safetensors - Download Temporal Upscaler - Supported by the model and will be required for future pipeline implementations ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors - Download Distilled LoRA - Required for current two-stage pipeline implementations in this repository (except DistilledPipeline, ICLoraPipeline, and LipDubPipeline) ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors - Download Gemma Text Encoder (download all assets from the repository) Gemma 3 LoRAs LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Union-Control - Download LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Motion-Track-Control - Download LTX-2-19b-IC-LoRA-Detailer - Download LTX-2-19b-IC-LoRA-Pose-Control - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Dolly-In - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Dolly-Left - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Dolly-Out - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Dolly-Right - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Jib-Down - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Jib-Up - Download LTX-2-19b-LoRA-Camera-Control-Static - Download LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-HDR - HDR IC-LoRA and pre-computed text embeddings for HDRICLoraPipeline LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-LipDub - Download Available Pipelines TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline - Production-quality text/image-to-video with 2x upsampling (recommended) TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline - Same two-stage flow as above but uses the res_2s second-order sampler (fewer steps, better quality) TI2VidOneStagePipeline - Single-stage generation for quick prototyping DistilledPipeline - Fastest inference with 8 predefined sigmas ICLoraPipeline - Video-to-video and image-to-video transformations (uses distilled model.) KeyframeInterpolationPipeline - Interpolate between keyframe images A2VidPipelineTwoStage - Audio-to-video generation conditioned on an input audio file RetakePipeline - Regenerate a specific time region of an existing video HDRICLoraPipeline - Video-to-video with HDR output (linear float frames via LogC3 inverse decode, suitable for EXR export and tonemapping) LipDubPipeline - Lip dubbing, rephrasing, matching speaker identity (distilled model, single IC-LoRA, Two stages). ⚡ Optimization Tips Use DistilledPipeline - Fastest inference with only 8 predefined sigmas (8 steps stage 1, 4 steps stage 2) Enable FP8 quantization - Enables lower memory footprint: --quantization fp8-cast (CLI) or quantization=QuantizationPolicy.fp8_cast() (Python). Fp8-cast should be used with bf16 checkpoints, it shall downcast them on the fly. For Hopper GPUs with TensorRT-LLM, use --quantization fp8-scaled-mm for FP8 scaled matrix multiplication. Fp8-scaled-mm should be used with fp8 checkpoints. Install attention optimizations - On datacenter Blackwell GPUs (B200), install FlashAttention 4 manually: uv pip install 'flash-attn-4==4.0.0b9' (this specific revision is the one we have verified against torch 2.9.1+cu128; newer betas have known issues on consumer Blackwell). On other CUDA GPUs (including Hopper), use xFormers (uv sync --extra xformers). Use gradient estimation - Reduce inference steps from 40 to 20-30 while maintaining quality (see pipeline documentation) Skip memory cleanup - If you have sufficient VRAM, disable automatic memory cleanup between stages for faster processing Choose single-stage pipeline - Use TI2VidOneStagePipeline for faster generation when high resolution isn't required ✍️ Prompting for LTX-2 When writing prompts, focus on detailed, chronological descriptions of actions and scenes. Include specific movements, appearances, camera angles, and environmental details - all in a single flowing paragraph. Start directly with the action, and keep descriptions literal and precise. Think like a cinematographer describing a shot list. Keep within 200 words. For best results, build your prompts using this structure: Start with main action in a single sentence Add specific details about movements and gestures Describe character/object appearances precisely Include background and environment details Specify camera angles and movements Describe lighting and colors Note any changes or sudden events For additional guidance on writing a prompt please refer to https://ltx.video/blog/how-to-prompt-for-ltx-2 Automatic Prompt Enhancement LTX-2 pipelines support automatic prompt enhancement via an enhance_prompt parameter. 🔌 ComfyUI Integration To use our model with ComfyUI, please follow the instructions at https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/. 📦 Packages This repository is organized as a monorepo with three main packages: ltx-core - Core model implementation, inference stack, and utilities ltx-pipelines - High-level pipeline implementations for text-to-video, image-to-video, and other generation modes ltx-trainer - Training and fine-tuning tools for LoRA, full fine-tuning, and IC-LoRA Each package has its own README and documentation. See the Documentation section below. 📚 Documentation Each package includes comprehensive documentation: LTX-Core README - Core model implementation, inference stack, and utilities LTX-Pipelines README - High-level pipeline implementations and usage guides LTX-Trainer README - Training and fine-tuning documentation with detailed guides
articles.tldr: Lightricks 发布开源 DiT 音视频基础模型 LTX-2
articles.objective_summary: Lightricks 于 GitHub 开源发布 LTX-2，这是首个基于 DiT 架构的音频-视频联合基础模型，支持同步音视频生成、文生视频、图生视频、音频转视频、口型同步等多种推理管线，提供 FP8 量化与 FlashAttention 加速，并附带训练与微调工具。
key_logic_flow: Lightricks 发布 LTX-2，这是首个基于 DiT 架构的音频-视频基础模型，支持同步音频与视频生成。
项目以开源形式发布在 GitHub，包含 ltx-core（核心模型）、ltx-pipelines（推理管线）、ltx-trainer（训练工具）三大子包。
提供多种推理管线，涵盖文生视频、图生视频、音频转视频、口型同步、关键帧插值、视频重拍等功能。
支持 FP8 量化、FlashAttention-4（Blackwell GPU）、xFormers（Hopper GPU）等加速方案以降低显存占用。
模型支持多种 LoRA 控制方式，包括 IC-LoRA 联合控制、运动轨迹控制、姿态控制、相机运动控制等。
用户可通过命令行或 Python API 调用模型，并支持 ComfyUI 集成。

impact_score.reason: LTX-2 是首个基于 DiT 架构的音频-视频联合基础模型，填补了开源领域同步音视频生成的技术空白。其开放了完整的训练工具链（LoRA/IC-LoRA/全参微调）、多种推理管线以及 FP8/FlashAttention-4 等生产级加速方案，显著降低了社区在视频生成方向的研究门槛。虽然不构成类似 ChatGPT 级别的范式转移，但它在开源视频生成赛道中是里程碑式的发布，将改变该领域的竞争格局，迫使其他闭源视频模型在开放策略上做出回应。综合评定 7.2 分。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 首个开源 DiT 音视频联合模型的可用性与训练微调能力

hype_assessment.reason: 该项目的 GitHub 发布文风偏技术实操，没有使用'颠覆'、'革命性'等 PR 滥用词汇，而是详细列出了技术架构、加速方案、依赖版本和具体使用方法。'first DiT-based audio-video foundation model' 的定位是事实性陈述且有技术依据。整体信息呈现务实、干货导向，不存在明显的概念炒作。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 首次将 DiT 架构扩展到音视频联合生成领域，实现单一基础模型内的文生视频、图生视频、音频转视频、口型同步、关键帧插值等多模态能力，并支持 FP8 量化、FlashAttention-4（Blackwell）、xFormers（Hopper）等分层加速方案，在工程上实现了训练与推理的完整工具链开源。
domain_disruption.business_model: Lightricks 将核心基础模型完全开源（含训练工具），走'开源社区生态 + 商业 API 服务'双轨模式，类似于 Meta 的 Llama 策略。这种'开源底座 + 增值云服务'的路径将对 Runway、Pika 等闭源视频生成公司形成竞争压力，推动行业整体向更开放的方向演进。

compound_value.reason: LTX-2 作为首个开源 DiT 音视频联合基础模型，具备显著的长期复利潜力。核心投资逻辑：(1) 音视频同步生成是视频生成领域尚未被充分占领的技术高地，LTX-2 率先以开源方式卡位，有机会成为社区事实标准；(2) 提供 ltx-trainer + 多种 LoRA 控制（姿态/轨迹/相机/HDR/唇形同步），降低开发者二次开发门槛，形成平台效应；(3) 支持 FP8 量化、FlashAttention-4、xFormers 等显存优化，降低了推理成本，加速生态扩散。但风险在于：开源视频模型赛道竞争激烈（CogVideo、Open-Sora、Mochi 等），Lightricks 作为盈利性公司能否长期持续投入开源项目存在不确定性；此外视频生成极度依赖算力，社区贡献者的算力门槛限制了生态成长速度。综合评估，若能建成活跃的开源生态，3-5 年后有望成为视频生成领域的 Linux 级基础设施，但当前仍处于早期验证阶段。

key_beneficiaries: 开源 AI 视频社区
competitive_casualty: Runway ML
Pika Labs
闭源视频生成 API 服务商
OpenAI Sora (潜在市场份额侵蚀)
market_opportunities: 内容创作者和影视制作团队可直接利用 LTX-2 开源模型搭建一站式音视频生成管线，大幅降低从文本/图片到成品视频的后期制作成本
企业可基于 LTX-2 的多种 LoRA 控制能力（姿态、相机运动、口型同步等），开发面向广告营销、游戏过场动画、虚拟主播等垂直场景的微调解决方案
围绕 LTX-2 的 ComfyUI 集成生态和训练工具链（LoRA/IC-LoRA/全量微调），可以构建面向创作者的模型服务 SaaS 或企业级定制化训练平台

risk_matrix.regulatory: 视频生成模型在欧盟 AI Act 下可能被归类为高风险应用，特别是同步音频生成能力面临合成媒体标识（watermarking）、深度伪造检测等合规要求；开源发布增加了监管追溯难度
risk_matrix.technological: DiT 架构正快速演进，Sora、CogVideoX 等竞品持续迭代，LTX-2 的架构领先窗口期有限；FP8 量化与 FlashAttention-4 的加速方案高度依赖特定 GPU 平台（Blackwell/Hopper），普通用户的推理成本仍较高
risk_matrix.competitive: 视频生成赛道竞争白热化，Runway、Pika、OpenAI Sora、Meta 等巨头持续投入，LTX-2 作为开源方案虽在可控性和成本上有优势，但商业生态可能被闭源巨头的 API 生态挤压
risk_matrix.ethical: 音频-视频联合生成能力大幅降低了深度伪造门槛，口型同步（LipDub）和音频转视频功能极易被用于政治虚假信息、色情替换等恶意场景，且开源分发增加了滥用追踪的难度

articles.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
articles.description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.codebase-memory-mcp The fastest and most efficient code intelligence engine for AI coding agents. Full-indexes an average repository in milliseconds, the Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) in 3 minutes. Answers structural queries in under 1ms. Ships as a single static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows — download, run install, done. High-quality parsing through tree-sitter AST analysis across all 158 languages, enhanced with Hybrid LSP semantic type resolution for Python, TypeScript / JavaScript / JSX / TSX, PHP, C#, Go, C, C++, Java, Kotlin, and Rust — producing a persistent knowledge graph of functions, classes, call chains, HTTP routes, and cross-service links. 14 MCP tools. Zero dependencies. Plug and play across 11 coding agents. Research — The design and benchmarks behind this project are described in the preprint Codebase-Memory: Tree-Sitter-Based Knowledge Graphs for LLM Code Exploration via MCP (arXiv:2603.27277). Evaluated across 31 real-world repositories: 83% answer quality, 10× fewer tokens, 2.1× fewer tool calls vs. file-by-file exploration. Security & Trust — This tool reads your codebase and writes to your agent configuration files. That is what it is designed to do. If you prefer to audit before running, the full source is here — every release binary is signed, checksummed, and scanned by 70+ antivirus engines. All processing happens 100% locally; your code never leaves your machine. Found a security issue? We want to know — see SECURITY.md. Security is Priority #1 for us. Built-in 3D graph visualization (UI variant) — explore your knowledge graph at localhost:9749 Why codebase-memory-mcp Extreme indexing speed — Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) in 3 minutes. RAM-first pipeline: LZ4 compression, in-memory SQLite, fused Aho-Corasick pattern matching. Memory released after indexing. Plug and play — single static binary for macOS (arm64/amd64), Linux (arm64/amd64), and Windows (amd64). No Docker, no runtime dependencies, no API keys. Download → install → restart agent → done. 158 languages — vendored tree-sitter grammars compiled into the binary. Nothing to install, nothing that breaks. 120x fewer tokens — 5 structural queries: ~3,400 tokens vs ~412,000 via file-by-file search. One graph query replaces dozens of grep/read cycles. 11 agents, one command — install auto-detects Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Zed, OpenCode, Antigravity, Aider, KiloCode, VS Code, OpenClaw, and Kiro — configures MCP entries, instruction files, and pre-tool hooks for each. Built-in graph visualization — 3D interactive UI at localhost:9749 (optional UI binary variant). Infrastructure-as-code indexing — Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, and Kustomize overlays indexed as graph nodes with cross-references. Resource nodes for K8s kinds, Module nodes for Kustomize overlays with IMPORTS edges to referenced resources. 14 MCP tools — search, trace, architecture, impact analysis, Cypher queries, dead code detection, cross-service HTTP linking, ADR management, and more. Quick Start One-line install (macOS / Linux): curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/main/install.sh | bash With graph visualization UI: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --ui Windows (PowerShell): # 1. Download the installer Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/main/install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1 # 2. (Optional but recommended) Inspect the script notepad install.ps1 # 3. Run it .\install.ps1 Options: --ui (graph visualization), --skip-config (binary only, no agent setup), --dir=<path> (custom location). Restart your coding agent. Say "Index this project" — done. Manual install Download the archive for your platform from the latest release: codebase-memory-mcp-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz (macOS/Linux) or .zip (Windows) — standard codebase-memory-mcp-ui-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz / .zip — with graph visualization Extract and install (each archive includes install.sh or install.ps1): macOS / Linux: tar xzf codebase-memory-mcp-*.tar.gz ./install.sh Windows (PowerShell): Expand-Archive codebase-memory-mcp-windows-amd64.zip -DestinationPath . .\install.ps1 Restart your coding agent. The install command automatically strips macOS quarantine attributes and ad-hoc signs the binary — no manual xattr/codesign needed. The install command auto-detects all installed coding agents and configures MCP server entries, instruction files, skills, and pre-tool hooks for each. Graph Visualization UI If you downloaded the ui variant: codebase-memory-mcp --ui=true --port=9749 Open http://localhost:9749 in your browser. The UI runs as a background thread alongside the MCP server — it's available whenever your agent is connected. Auto-Index Enable automatic indexing on MCP session start: codebase-memory-mcp config set auto_index true When enabled, new projects are indexed automatically on first connection. Previously-indexed projects are registered with the background watcher for ongoing git-based change detection. Configurable file limit: config set auto_index_limit 50000. Keeping Up to Date codebase-memory-mcp update The MCP server also checks for updates on startup and notifies on the first tool call if a newer release is available. Uninstall codebase-memory-mcp uninstall Removes all agent configs, skills, hooks, and instructions. Does not remove the binary or SQLite databases. Features Graph & analysis Architecture overview: get_architecture returns languages, packages, entry points, routes, hotspots, boundaries, layers, and clusters in a single call Architecture Decision Records: manage_adr persists architectural decisions across sessions Louvain community detection: Discovers functional modules by clustering call edges Git diff impact mapping: detect_changes maps uncommitted changes to affected symbols with risk classification Call graph: Resolves function calls across files and packages (import-aware, type-inferred) Dead code detection: Finds functions with zero callers, excluding entry points Cypher-like queries: MATCH (f:Function)-[:CALLS]->(g) WHERE f.name = 'main' RETURN g.name Search Semantic search (semantic_query): vector search across the entire graph, powered by bundled Nomic nomic-embed-code embeddings (40K tokens, 768d int8) compiled into the binary — no API key, no Ollama, no Docker. 11-signal combined scoring (TF-IDF, RRI, API/Type/Decorator signatures, AST profiles, data flow, Halstead-lite, MinHash, module proximity, graph diffusion). BM25 full-text search via SQLite FTS5 with cbm_camel_split tokenizer (camelCase / snake_case aware) Structural search (search_graph): regex name patterns, label filters, min/max degree, file scoping Code search (search_code): graph-augmented grep over indexed files only Cross-service linking HTTP route ↔ call-site matching with confidence scoring gRPC, GraphQL, tRPC service detection with Memory released after. Distribution & operation Single static binary, zero infrastructure: SQLite-backed, persists to ~/.cache/codebase-memory-mcp/ Auto-sync: Background watcher detects file changes and re-indexes automatically Route nodes: REST endpoints are first-class graph entities CLI mode: codebase-memory-mcp cli search_graph '{"name_pattern": ".*Handler.*"}' Available on: npm, PyPI, Homebrew, Scoop, Winget, Chocolatey, AUR, go install Team-Shared Graph Artifact Commit a single compressed file to your repo and your teammates skip the reindex. .codebase-memory/graph.db.zst is a zstd-compressed snapshot of the knowledge graph that lives next to your source. When you index, the artifact is written or refreshed; when a teammate clones the repo and runs codebase-memory-mcp for the first time, the artifact is decompressed and incremental indexing fills in their local diff. Format: SQLite database, indexes stripped, VACUUM INTO compacted, then zstd 1.5.7 compressed (8–13:1 ratio typical) Two tiers: Best (zstd -9 + index strip + VACUUM INTO) — written on explicit index_repository Fast (zstd -3) — written by the watcher for low-latency incremental updates Bootstrap: when no local DB exists but the artifact is present, index_repository imports the artifact first, then runs incremental indexing — avoiding the full reindex cost No merge pain: a .gitattributes line with merge=ours is auto-created on first export, so concurrent edits don't produce conflicts on the binary artifact Optional: never committed unless you want it. Add .codebase-memory/ to .gitignore if you prefer everyone to reindex from scratch. The result is similar in spirit to graphify's graphify-out/ directory, but as a single compressed file with explicit two-tier export, integrity-checked import, and zero merge friction. How It Works codebase-memory-mcp is a structural analysis backend — it builds and queries the knowledge graph. It does not include an LLM. Instead, it relies on your MCP client (Claude Code, or any MCP-compatible agent) to be the intelligence layer. You: "what calls ProcessOrder?" Agent calls: trace_path(function_name="ProcessOrder", direction="inbound") codebase-memory-mcp: executes graph query, returns structured results Agent: presents the call chain in plain English Why no built-in LLM? Other code graph tools embed an LLM for natural language → graph query translation. This means extra API keys, extra cost, and another model to configure. With MCP, the agent you're already talking to is the query translator. Performance Benchmarked on Apple M3 Pro: Operation Time Notes Linux kernel full index 3 min 28M LOC, 75K files → 4.81M nodes, 7.72M edges Linux kernel fast index 1m 12s 1.88M nodes Django full index ~6s 49K nodes, 196K edges Cypher query <1ms Relationship traversal Name search (regex) <10ms SQL LIKE pre-filtering Dead code detection ~150ms Full graph scan with degree filtering Trace call path (depth=5) <10ms BFS traversal RAM-first pipeline: All indexing runs in memory (LZ4 HC compressed read, in-memory SQLite, single dump at end). Memory is released back to the OS after indexing completes. Token efficiency: Five structural queries consumed ~3,400 tokens via codebase-memory-mcp versus ~412,000 tokens via file-by-file grep exploration — a 99.2% reduction. For Claude Code, the PreToolUse hook intercepts Grep/Glob (never Read — gating Read breaks the read-before-edit invariant) and, when the search token matches indexed symbols, injects them as additionalContext via search_graph so the agent gets structured context alongside its normal search results.
